this was supposed to be shipped on the 12th of november, and once again no information that it got delayed.... i am running after you guys, not the way its should be...

You're right, Thomas, and I'm sorry. You shouldn't have to chase us for this.

November 12 was the day the units left the factory, and they did. What we didn't do was tell you that means your unit ships to you by November 30, once the stock lands and is checked in at our Rotterdam warehouse. That should have come from us without you asking.

The tracking email goes out automatically the moment it ships. It's worth adding (email hidden) to your contacts so it doesn't end up in spam.
